{
  "dataset_name": "blood_transfusion",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "v1_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized V1 (Recency) using training mean and std for scale-normalized distance.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ensures V1 contributes proportionally in Euclidean neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1 - 9.120805369127517) / 6.971574838386195"
    },
    {
      "name": "v2_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized V2 (Frequency) for scale-normalized distances.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Balances V2's contribution against larger-scale features in distance computation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V2 - 5.771812080536913) / 5.544355380216525"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_log_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed V3 (Monetary) then standardized to compress heavy tail before distance computation.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Log compression prevents large V3 values from dominating KNN distances.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(V3) - 7.0) / 1.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "v4_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized V4 (Time) for fair distance contribution.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes V4 to comparable scale with other features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V4 - 35.25503355704698) / 24.100782343372842"
    },
    {
      "name": "avg_donation_volume",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average volume per donation (V3/V2), a stable per-event magnitude.",
      "value_range": [200.0, 300.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures per-donation magnitude that groups similar donors in neighborhood space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V3 / np.maximum(V2, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "donation_density",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Donations per unit time (V2 / V4), how frequently the donor gives.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Donor behavior intensity that clusters similar engagement patterns.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V2 / np.maximum(V4, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "recency_over_tenure",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of months since last donation to total tenure (V1/V4); inactivity ratio.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights lapsed vs. active donors, important separator in KNN geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(V1 / np.maximum(V4, 1), 0, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "active_span",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Span between first donation and most recent (V4 - V1), period of donor activity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 98.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Distinguishes long-active from short-active donors in neighborhood.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(V4 - V1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_median_donor",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance in standardized space to an unsupervised central prototype (training medians).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a global centrality signal useful for distance-based separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((V1 - 9.120805369127517) / 6.971574838386195) ** 2 + ((V2 - 5.771812080536913) / 5.544355380216525) ** 2 + ((np.log1p(V3) - 7.0) / 1.0) ** 2 + ((V4 - 35.25503355704698) / 24.100782343372842) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "recent_active_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for donors whose recency is small relative to overall recency scale.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Binary cluster tag separating recently-active region of feature space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V1 <= 4, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_frequency_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for donors with frequency above the training mean.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Cluster flag for high-engagement donors aiding neighborhood discrimination.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V2 >= 6, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "donor_engagement_profile",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic engagement score combining short recency, high frequency, and long tenure; higher = more engaged loyal donor profile. Computed as np.clip((1 - np.clip(V1/24, 0, 1)) * 0.4 + np.clip(V2/15, 0, 1) * 0.3 + np.clip(V4/80, 0, 1) * 0.3, 0, 1).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic interpretable similarity dimension that improves neighborhood grouping by donor archetype.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((1 - np.clip(V1 / 24, 0, 1)) * 0.4 + np.clip(V2 / 15, 0, 1) * 0.3 + np.clip(V4 / 80, 0, 1) * 0.3, 0, 1)"
    }
  ]
}
